## maven-install-plugin-3.2.0
## 🚀 New features and improvements

- Cache projectsUsingPlugin to fix O(N²) reactor scan ([#444](https://github.com/apache/maven-install-plugin/pull/444)) @slawekjaranowski

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- chore: harden embedded-POM trust boundary in install:install-file (3.x backport) ([#447](https://github.com/apache/maven-install-plugin/pull/447)) @gnodet

## 📝 Documentation updates

- Restore the common wording on the download page ([#438](https://github.com/apache/maven-install-plugin/pull/438)) @slachiewicz
- Add AGENTS.md + SECURITY.md security-model pointer for scanner discoverability ([#416](https://github.com/apache/maven-install-plugin/pull/416)) @potiuk

## 👻 Maintenance

- Use JSR-330 for component injection ([#442](https://github.com/apache/maven-install-plugin/pull/442)) @slawekjaranowski

- Fix ITs for Maven 3.10.x ([#409](https://github.com/apache/maven-install-plugin/pull/409)) @slawekjaranowski
- Migration to JUnit 5 - avoid using AbstractMojoTestCase ([#396](https://github.com/apache/maven-install-plugin/pull/396)) @slawekjaranowski
- Bump m-invoker-p to 3.9.1 ([#376](https://github.com/apache/maven-install-plugin/pull/376)) @slachiewicz
